known_limitations: Implements an MVP subset of the requirements with a local SQLite store and a simple web UI.
Advanced collaboration features such as true real-time concurrent editing, complex merge UI, and notification delivery are represented only in a simplified form.
Import mapping, conflict resolution, and glossary checks are heuristic and not full enterprise-grade policy analysis.
Issue-tracker and repository integrations are not connected to external systems in this delivery.
The application is intended for the managed internal environment; public cloud deployment is not implemented.
